html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Meet the powerful team of machines 
built for combat and control!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the January Update,
featuring the Mighty Machines theme.

 

Ultron, Vision, and Destroyer, each created to enforce their own version of order, 
have received New Uniforms and Tier-4 Advancements. 
Additionally, Sentinel, tasked with the mission to neutralize mutants, 
has received a New Uniform along with Tier-3 and Tier-4 Advancements.

 

We have also improved World Boss convenience 
to help you challenge higher stages faster.
Furthermore, a new Team-Up Collection theme has been added exclusively 
to support the growth of Fantastic Four-related heroes.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 


▣ Four New Uniforms


To celebrate the Mighty Machines themed update, four new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Ultron <All-Father Ultron>, Vision <Ultimate Vision>, 
Destroyer <The Mighty Thor> and Sentinel <Stark Sentinels MK Ⅱ>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The four new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <January Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 


▣ Ultron, Vision, Destroyer and Sentinel Tier-4

Tier-4 Advancements have been added for Ultron, Vision, Destroyer, and Sentinel,
combat machines built for societal control.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

  

 


▣ Sentinel Tier-3

Sentinel has received its Tier-3 Ultimate Skill.
Born from the fear of mutants, 
this ability is one of the many means the Sentinel employs to carry out its directives.

 

 

 


▣ Gorgon and Lash Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Gorgon and Lash will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the January Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ World Boss Improvements

 

The “World Boss” content, 
where you strategize with various heroes to take on powerful Bosses, 
has been improved to allow faster progression to higher stages.

 

① You can now continue to challenge the next stage even after clearing the World Boss 5 times.
- Even after 5 clears, heroes cannot be reused until the daily reset. 
Each hero can still only be used once per day.
* After the initial 5 clears, basic clear rewards will no longer be distributed. 
You can only obtain the following:
Only the following rewards/records can be obtained.
▶ Character Potential Points (once per day per hero), World Boss Challenge Record, S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive Collectibles, Stage Clear Records, First Clear Reward, World Boss Unlock Challenge Completion Count
* "S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Special Support+" benefits will not apply once the basic reward count is exhausted.

 

 

② Balance and Pattern adjustments have been made for Legend+ Stages
▶ Legend+ (Black Swan) Stage
- Removed the pattern where the Force Field reactivates at certain HP thresholds after being destroyed.
- Slightly increased Black Swan's stun duration upon Force Field destruction.
- Improved boss attack patterns when below certain HP thresholds.
- Slightly decreased HP.
- Increased damage for certain attacks.

 

▶ Legend+ (Corvus & Proxima) Stage
- Adjusted the system to allow skipping special patterns depending on the combat situation.
- Adjusted the number of spear throws (Proxima Midnight's special pattern) and the activation timing of Corvus Glaive’s interference skills.
- Slightly decreased HP.

 

▶ Legend+ (Black Dwarf & Maw) Stage
- Shortened the duration of special patterns for Black Dwarf and Ebony Maw that trigger at specific HP thresholds.
- Improved the visual effects for Aether generation.

 

▶ Legend+ (Thanos) Stage
- Slightly decreased HP.

 

③ The “Training Mode” button, which becomes available after clearing the World Boss 5 times, has been moved to a separate button.
- Training Mode is only available for World Bosses that have been unlocked.

 

 

④ A new popup has been added where you can check the First Clear rewards for the World Boss.
- This can be viewed from the Select Difficulty screen.

 


 

▣ New Team-Up Collection: Fantastic Four & Improvements


A new theme has been added to the Team-Up Collection, where you can complete assigned missions to gain powerful effects that assist you in battle.


1. A new Fantastic Four themed Team-Up Collection has been added.

 

 

* If the same hero is included in different Team-Up Collection themes, the following rules apply.
- Collection Option: Only the effect from the theme with the highest Collection Option will be applied. 
- Team-Up Option: All Team-Up Options from each theme will be applied individually.


2. Store (Collection Token): "Collection Token: Fantastic Four" has been added to the Store's item list.


3. Alliance Battle: "Collection Token: The Defenders" has been added to the contents of the "Collection Token Supply Chest," which can be earned upon reaching specific score milestones.


4. Craft (Team-Up Collection): "Collection Token: The Defenders" has been added to the list of craftable items.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

After the January update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for 
Vision, Sentinel, Gorgon and Lash will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[January Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 


▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Mighty Machines theme.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals & Other Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 1/20 Maintenance - 2/17 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 1/20 Maintenance - 2/17 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

2. Some ‘Time Attack’ products, available only under specific conditions, will be discontinued or revamped.
Discontinued: "A chance to get 120% bonus Crystals!"
Upcoming: "A chance to get 200% bonus Crystals!", "A chance to get 300% bonus Crystals!"
* Please check in-game for further details.

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Team Battle Arena: A Favorites system and Filter functions have been added to the search feature.
- Favorites: Heroes marked as Favorites will now appear at the top of the hero list.
- Cost Filter: A Cost filter has been added, allowing you to sort heroes in both ascending and descending order by Cost.

 

 

2. When attempting to equip a new Custom Gear while a ‘C.T.P.’ grade custom gear is already equipped, the warning popup has been improved to clearly display which specific C.T.P. will be destroyed.

 

 

3. Dimension Mission: The purchase quantity for items in the 'Material' tab in the Support Shop has been increased.
- Norn Stone of Strength / Energy / Brilliance / Omnipotence, M'kraan Shard, Gear Up Kit, Dimension Debris, Uniform Upgrade Kit, Component Pack, and Stark-Branded Blueprint.

 

4. Giant Boss Raid: The available Quick Chat phrases during battle have been changed.
- Before: Attack!, Watch out!, I need some support!, Thank you!
- After: Spread out!, Assemble here!, I'm sorry., Thank you very much!

 

5. The 'Display Custom Gear' setting in the My Team screen will now persist even after restarting the game.
* This setting will reset if the game is reinstalled.

 

6. World Event: After completing 2 participations, the World Event will now correctly show as “Completed” on the Content Status Board.

 

7. When a hero's skill reaches its maximum level through upgrading, the upgrade screen will no longer automatically close.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. Alliance Battle: Fixed an issue in Training Mode where selecting a different difficulty after choosing a non-current round would cause the selection to revert to the current day's round.


2. Story: Fixed an issue where Auto Play would occasionally cause characters to get stuck or stop moving in certain areas of the Ultimate 4-1: Crack in the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
